Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nitin - 36 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Anjali - 55 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Rajesh - 67 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Sunita - 30 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Nitin stands on the road. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "What lovely weather!"

[Nitin steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Nitin (happily): "Exactly right."

[Nitin waits at the zebra crossing and then crosses the road.]

Anjali: "That was such a fun day!"
